analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 27.5, entering oversold territory, with a 5-day consecutive downtrend. MACD histogram also worsening at -0.3285, maintaining the bearish trend. The 52-week low of $56.56 may act as a short-term support. Current price $58.10 is near the lower Bollinger Band of $57.18. Volume is at 1.16x the 5-day average, indicating normal levels. As a 15-year swing trader, the current phase requires a wait-and-see approach rather than initiating new buys, pending further indicator confirmation.
